hook_text: Welcome to the shop where every answer is a property. What can we help you with?
clip_script: Customer one: is it a metal? Shiny, malleable, ductile, carries heat: yes! Charcoal? Dull and brittle: non-metal. Customer two: my gate is rusting. Only iron and steel rust. Paint it! Customer three: pick up nails? Use a magnet: iron and steel only. Customer four: build a room. Concrete: mix and set. Bricks: mix, dry and fire. Glass, tiles, paint: strong, waterproof, fire resistant, colourful. Term 2, sold!
visual_style: Whiteboard shop counter with four customers, each getting a material and a property label.
mood: Lively and funny, like a busy shop with quick-thinking assistants.
pacing: Four customers, four problems, four quick property answers.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and play shop assistant with a friend.
